sponsored.t: Relates to a license to sell liquor at retail for consumption on certain premises
sponsored.sum: Relates to a license to sell liquor at retail for consumption on certain premises in the county of Greene.

sponsored.t: Relates to a license to sell liquor at retail for consumption on certain premises
sponsored.sum: Relates to a license to sell liquor at retail for consumption on certain premises in the county of Schoharie.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the discontinuance of certain parkland in the town of Windham, located in the county of Greene
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the discontinuance of certain parkland in the town of Windham, located in the county of Greene, for the purposes of decommissioning an old baseball facility and pedestrian safety.

sponsored.t: Establishes the office of justice court fee recovery and justice court fee reimbursement fund
sponsored.sum: Establishes the office of justice court fee recovery, which is charged with collecting fees in criminal actions and other proceedings on behalf of justice courts.

sponsored.t: Provides for recall of a statewide elective officer
sponsored.sum: Provides for recall of a statewide elective officer; empowers the citizens with the ability to remove elective officers.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the county seat in Delaware county to have at least one polling place designated for early voting
sponsored.sum: Requires the county seat in Delaware county (Delhi) to have at least one polling place designated for early voting.

sponsored.t: Establishes the NY food insecurity, farm resiliency and rural poverty initiative; repealer; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Establishes the NY food insecurity, farm resiliency and rural poverty initiative to provide financial assistance in the form of matching grants, hiring assistance, purchasing assistance, tax credits, tax exemptions, and reimbursements.

sponsored.t: Establishes a veterans in agriculture assistance and outreach program
sponsored.sum: Establishes a veterans in agriculture assistance and outreach program to help integrate veterans into the field of agriculture, and support veterans currently working in agriculture; designs an associated logotype for the promotion of products produced by a veteran or qualified veteran business entity.

sponsored.t: Establishes a blue ribbon commission on fair competition in the outdoor recreation industry
sponsored.sum: Establishes a blue ribbon commission on fair competition in the outdoor recreation industry to examine, evaluate and make recommendations regarding methods to promote fair competition in the outdoor recreation industry; provides such commission shall consist of eleven appointed members; requires a report to the governor and legislature on or before December 31, 2026.

sponsored.t: Permits schools located within the state to purchase certain New York milk
sponsored.sum: Permits schools located within the state to purchase reduced fat or whole New York milk to provide or sell at such school.

sponsored.t: Provides for instruction in food and agriculture in elementary and high school
sponsored.sum: Provides for instruction in food and agriculture in schools using a curriculum established by the commissioner of education in consultation with the commissioner of agriculture and markets.

sponsored.t: Requires public schools to provide at least one flavored milk option at scheduled meal periods
sponsored.sum: Requires public schools to provide at least one flavored milk option at scheduled meal periods.

sponsored.t: Relates to protecting children under the age of eighteen from endangerment
sponsored.sum: Establishes legislation to protect children under the age of eighteen from inappropriate communication which creates the foreseeable risk of endangering the child's emotional, mental or physical welfare.

sponsored.t: Prohibits level 2 and 3 sex offenders from residing within 1,500 feet of their victim or school grounds; also prohibits such offenders from attending school activities
sponsored.sum: Prohibits level 2 and 3 sex offenders from residing within 1,500 feet of their victim or school grounds; prohibits such offenders from attending or participating in school sponsored activities.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the percentage of disbursements from the state lottery fund that goes towards education aid from falling below 45.15%
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the percentage of disbursements from the state lottery fund that goes towards education aid from falling below 45.15 percent.

sponsored.t: Prohibits grass clippings from being thrown or deposited upon any highway
sponsored.sum: Prohibits grass clippings from being thrown or deposited upon any highway.

sponsored.t: Requires the commissioner of education of the state of New York to conduct a study on the sufficiency of current education aid apportionment formulas and make recommendations for improvements to such formulas
sponsored.sum: Requires the commissioner of education of the state of New York to conduct a study on the sufficiency of current education aid apportionment formulas, make recommendations for improvements to such formulas and deliver a report of such findings and recommendations and provides for the repeal of such provisions upon expiration thereof.

sponsored.t: Prohibits certain COVID-19 mask and face covering mandates by state agencies
sponsored.sum: Prohibits state agencies from promulgating rules, regulations or any form of guidance requiring individuals under the age of eighteen who are not exhibiting COVID-19 related symptoms, as defined by the centers for disease control and prevention, to wear a mask or face covering in a public place or while participating in any recreational or organized sporting activity.

sponsored.t: Authorizes and directs the commissioner of health to designate HTLV-1 and HTLV-2 communicable diseases; and relates to the HTLV-1 and HTLV-2 viruses
sponsored.sum: Authorizes and directs the commissioner of health to designate HTLV-1 and HTLV-2 communicable diseases; requires reporting of HTLV-1 and HTLV-2 cases to the department of health; creates educational materials about the virus.

sponsored.t: Increases the penalty for certain traffic violations when such violations arise out of the same incident as a conviction for failure to move over and when such violations occurred in a work zone
sponsored.sum: Doubles the penalties for use of mobile telephones and use of portable electronic devices when such violations arise out of the same incident as a conviction for failure to move over and when such violations occurred in a work zone.

sponsored.t: Relates to school aid computer listings for school districts
sponsored.sum: Requires the commissioner of education to produce a school aid computer listing based on updated current law where there is no school aid computer listing produced by the commissioner in support of an executive budget request.

sponsored.t: Requires multiple liens on farm property to be paid in chronological order, with the earliest lien being paid off first and the most recent being paid last
sponsored.sum: Requires multiple liens on farm property to be paid in chronological order, with the earliest lien being paid off first and the most recent being paid last.

sponsored.t: Establishes a three year hiking trail safety pilot program
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of environmental conservation and the office of parks, recreation and historic preservation to establish a three year hiking trail safety pilot program.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing a state income tax exemption for volunteer firefighters and volunteer ambulance workers
sponsored.sum: Provides a state income tax exemption for volunteer firefighters and volunteer ambulance workers who have qualifying service in the taxable year for which such exemption is sought.

sponsored.t: Relates to electric generating facility annual reports; and to repeal section 575-b of the real property tax law relating to solar or wind energy) systems
sponsored.sum: Eliminates the necessity for solar and wind energy systems to supply certain information in electric generating facility annual reports; repeals provisions relating to solar or wind energy systems.

sponsored.t: Provides for the presence of either a uniformed court officer or law enforcement officer during court proceedings
sponsored.sum: Provides for the chief administrator of the courts to, upon request by a municipality, ensure the assignment and presence of a uniformed court officer during court proceedings or a law enforcement officer where no uniformed court officer is available.

sponsored.t: Relates to the operation of vehicles when approaching a parked, stopped or standing authorized emergency vehicle or hazard vehicle or vehicle displaying a blue or green light
sponsored.sum: Relates to the operation of vehicles when approaching a parked, stopped or standing authorized emergency vehicle or hazard vehicle or vehicle displaying a blue or green light; provides for mandatory revocation of a driver's license for a period of six months where a person violates section 1144-a of the vehicle and traffic law and causes serious physical injury or death to another person; directs the division of criminal justice services to establish a public information campaign to instruct the public that operating a motor vehicle when approaching a parked, stopped or standing authorized emergency vehicle or hazard vehicle or vehicle displaying a blue or green light that results in…

sponsored.t: Creates a day care assistance program for members of the organized militia serving active duty; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Creates a day care assistance program for members of the organized militia serving federal active duty outside the United States; appropriates $500,000 therefor.

sponsored.t: Provides for certain fee exemptions for disabled veterans
sponsored.sum: Grants all veterans with a disability seven free days of sporting activity in New York state.

sponsored.t: Establishes the reclaimed asphalt pavement pilot program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the reclaimed asphalt pavement pilot program for the purpose of utilization of reclaimed asphalt pavement in the construction or improvement of state and municipal highways or bridges.

sponsored.t: Requires the establishment of a legislative child care facility for use by members and staff of the legislature
sponsored.sum: Requires the establishment of a legislative child care facility for use of members and staff of the legislature to be located in a part of the empire state plaza complex that has legislative offices and to be contracted by a private child care provider; makes an appropriation therefor.

sponsored.t: Relates to procedures for certain temporary custody orders
sponsored.sum: Establishes procedures for temporary custody orders that include a fifty-fifty rebuttable presumption that the parents shall have temporary joint legal and shared physical custody and shall share equal parenting time.

sponsored.t: Relates to expanding criminal mischief in the third degree to include damaging property of another as an expression of political ideology
sponsored.sum: Provides that a person is guilty of criminal mischief in the third degree when such person intentionally damages property of another person to promote or suppress a political ideology, or otherwise as an expression of political ideology.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing grocery store wine licenses
sponsored.sum: Establishes grocery store wine licenses permitting the licensee to sell from the licensed premises wine produced in New York state or produced from ingredients grown or produced in New York state, in sealed containers for consumption off such premises.

sponsored.t: Establishes standards for absentee ballot requests for an applicant
sponsored.sum: Establishes standards for absentee ballot requests for an applicant including requiring applicants to provide a statement if they do not possess an ID or social security number.

sponsored.t: Extends the authorization for additional sales and use tax for Schoharie county
sponsored.sum: Extends the authorization for additional sales and use tax for Schoharie county.

sponsored.t: Extends the authorization for Otsego county to impose additional rates of sales and compensating use taxes
sponsored.sum: Extends the authorization for Otsego county to impose additional rates of sales and compensating use taxes.

sponsored.t: Extends the authorization for imposition of additional sales and compensating use taxes in Greene county
sponsored.sum: Extends the authorization for imposition of additional sales and compensating use taxes in Greene county.

sponsored.t: Extends the authorization of the county of Greene to impose an additional mortgage recording tax
sponsored.sum: Extends the authorization of the county of Greene to impose an additional mortgage recording tax.

sponsored.t: Extends the authorization of the county of Delaware to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes
sponsored.sum: Extends the authorization of the county of Delaware to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes.

sponsored.t: Relates to the authority for the impose an additional mortgage recording tax in Otsego county
sponsored.sum: Extends the authority for the county of Otsego to impose an additional mortgage recording tax.

sponsored.t: Extends the authorization for the county of Schoharie to impose a county recording tax on obligation secured by a mortgage on real property
sponsored.sum: Extends the authorization for the county of Schoharie to impose a county recording tax on obligation secured by a mortgage on real property.

sponsored.t: Specifies the occupancy tax in the village of Catskill shall only apply to hotels and motels
sponsored.sum: Specifies the occupancy tax in the village of Catskill shall only apply to hotels and motels.

sponsored.t: Relates to the occupancy tax in the village of Coxsackie
sponsored.sum: Clarifies the scope of the occupancy tax in the village of Coxsackie.
